_comment: Report definition for the clients listing. Insert this document into the 'reports' collection of the primary mongo database (application.json -> mongo.database / mongo.report_table). The report reads the 'clients' collection from the 'blue-asset' database via the 'default' connection, then renders reports/clients.html. Run it with GET /run?name=clients (add &type=pdf for the PDF variant).
name: clients
description: All records in the clients collection (blue-asset database).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional client status shown in the report header (ACTIVE / ARCHIVED). Display only.
